description: Official Norwegian company check from the Enhetsregisteret (Brønnøysund Register Centre, open data). Look up by organisation number (exact) or search by name (up to 5 candidates). Returns official name, organisation form, industry code, employee count, registration date, business address and — directly from the register — bankruptcy and liquidation flags, with a direct register link. Companies only.

name.description: Company name to search (up to 5 candidates)

organisation_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisation number (exact), e.g. 923609016; provide this or 'name'
